art_space: 1280x720 (battle) - same tiles work on the overworld canvas at 1:1 device px

rain.draw: createPattern, fill viewport, offset y += 900 px/s, x += 160 px/s
rain.splashes: rain_splash_24x12.webp: 6-10 live at random ground points (y > 0.62 H), each plays once
rain.living.js: WEATHER.rain (coverage 0.7, wet) -> draw on the 'over' layer

storm.draw: pattern scroll y += 1500 px/s, x += 520 px/s

tint.op: multiply (or source-over at 0.22 alpha if multiply is slow)

lightning.safety: max 3 flashes per 10 s, never > 0.55 alpha (photosensitivity); respect a reduce-flashing setting

storm.plan_hook: storm season after beat_master_mirefen: rain + darker tint east of Fernwick

fog.draw: band a at y 0.45 H scrolled +18 px/s, band b at y 0.60 H scrolled -11 px/s, each stretched to 2x height, alpha 0.8
fog.battle_rule: keep fog BELOW the HP cards/message box layer and above the backdrop only; keep sprites above fog so they stay readable
fog.conflict: Gary's no-smoke/haze rule is for fx_extra particles; ambient fog is a weather layer, but needs his explicit OK
